## Summary
The capital city of Australia is Canberra, located in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT) in the southeastern part of the country. It was selected as a compromise between the rival cities of Sydney and Melbourne, with the federal Parliament officially transferring to the new capital in 1927 [Canberra | History, Map, Population, Climate, & Facts — Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/place/Canberra) [Why is Canberra the Capital of Australia — lovecanberra.com.au](https://lovecanberra.com.au/why-is-canberra-the-capital-of-australia).

## The Selection of Canberra
The choice of Canberra as the national capital was the result of a political compromise during the federation process in the early 20th century.

<summary>Historical context and the compromise between Sydney and Melbourne</summary>

Following the inauguration of the Commonwealth of Australia in 1901, there was significant disagreement between Sydney and Melbourne regarding which city should serve as the national capital [Why is Canberra the Capital of Australia — lovecanberra.com.au](https://lovecanberra.com.au/why-is-canberra-the-capital-of-australia) [What is the capital of Australia? To resolve this, it was decided that a new capital city would be built. The compromise stipulated that the new capital must be located in New South Wales but at least 100 miles (approximately 160 km) from Sydney [Why is Canberra the Capital of Australia — lovecanberra.com.au](https://lovecanberra.com.au/why-is-canberra-the-capital-of-australia) [Sydney isn't the capital of Australia! - Ovolo Hotels — ovolohotels.com](https://ovolohotels.com/ovolo/blog/sydney-isnt-the-capital-of-australia). During the interim period while the new capital was being constructed, the federal Parliament sat in Melbourne [Why is Canberra the Capital of Australia — lovecanberra.com.au](https://lovecanberra.com.au/why-is-canberra-the-capital-of-australia).

The site for Canberra was officially chosen in 1908, and a worldwide competition for the city's design was launched in 1911, which was won by American architect Walter Burley Griffin [Canberra | History, Map, Population, Climate, & Facts — Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/place/Canberra). The federal Parliament officially transferred to the new capital on May 9, 1927 [Canberra | History, Map, Population, Climate, & Facts — Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/place/Canberra).
</details>

## Common Misconceptions
It is a frequent misconception that Sydney or Melbourne serves as the capital of Australia.

*   **Sydney:** While it is the capital of the state of New South Wales, it has never been the capital of Australia [Why is Canberra the Capital of Australia — lovecanberra.com.au](https://lovecanberra.com.au/why-is-canberra-the-capital-of-australia).
*   **Melbourne:** It served as the interim seat of the federal Parliament from 1901 until 1927, but it was never the official capital of the Commonwealth of Australia [Why is Canberra the Capital of Australia — lovecanberra.com.au](https://lovecanberra.com.au/why-is-canberra-the-capital-of-australia).
</details>

## Conclusion
Canberra is the official capital of Australia, a status it has held since the federal Parliament moved there in 1927. It was purpose-built as a compromise to resolve the intense rivalry between Sydney and Melbourne, ensuring that neither of the two largest cities held the title of national capital.
